title: Passive Voice
explanation: Use the passive (be + past participle) when the action matters more than who does it, or when the doer is unknown: The report was sent yesterday. English is spoken here. The tense lives in be: is made (present), was made (past), has been made (present perfect). Add by + agent only when it adds useful information.
explanationPersian: جمله مجهول با فعل be و اسم مفعول ساخته می‌شود و وقتی به کار می‌رود که انجام‌دهنده کار ناشناخته یا کم‌اهمیت باشد. زمان جمله روی فعل be مشخص می‌شود. فقط وقتی لازم است، عامل را با by اضافه کنید.

examples.english: The office is cleaned every evening.

examples.persian: این پل در سال ۱۹۹۵ ساخته شد.

examples.english: This novel was written by a young author.
examples.persian: این رمان توسط نویسنده‌ای جوان نوشته شد.

exercises.prompt: The email ___ to all employees yesterday.

exercises.explanation: Present passive with a general fact: is spoken.

exercises.incorrectSentence: The project has been finish on time.
acceptedAnswers: The project has been finished on time.
exercises.explanation: Passive needs the past participle: been finished.
exercises.explanationPersian: در مجهول اسم مفعول لازم است: finished.

exercises.prompt: Choose the best passive version of: 'Someone stole my bike.'
options: My bike was stolen by someone.
exercises.explanation: The agent (someone) adds nothing — drop by someone.
Future passive: will be + past participle.
Present continuous passive: is being tested.
